title: 조기진급 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1

Article 5 (Committee for Evaluation of Early Promotion, Graduation and Admission)
(1) A Committee for Evaluation of Early Promotion, Graduation and Admission (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established at each school to conduct the following evaluations:
1. Evaluation for recognition of early completion of individual subjects under Article 3 (2);
2. Evaluation for granting qualifications for early admission to schools of higher level under Article 4 (2).
(2) The Committee shall consist of not fewer than five and not more than fifteen members, including one Chairperson.
(3) The vice principal of the school shall serve as the Chairperson: Provided, That at a school without a vice principal, a teacher designated by the head of the school shall serve as Chairperson.
(4) The Committee shall consist of teachers of the relevant school, parents of students and experts in education.
(5) A student subject to evaluation, or the student's parent, who objects to the results of an evaluation by the Committee may request a reevaluation through the head of the school within ten days after becoming aware of the results. In such cases, the Committee receiving the request shall conduct a reevaluation within fifteen days after receiving it.
(6) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Committee, etc., other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (5), shall be determined by school rules.
